title: White Swan
paragraphs: In the first world, Filo-tan was able to fly. If my memory serves me correctly, there must be a way to make Filo-tan fly. Ugh… What was I supposed to do again? The easiest way would be to have my current Father become the Father from back then, but that would have gotten me in serious trouble with Big Sister. …I have a vague idea, but let’s put that on hold for now. For what it’s worth… I’ve found that Yari and others with modification-related skills are listed in the check list. Let’s make various preparations so we can get Filo-tan to fly through the sky.
“Got it!”
“Well then, let’s wrap up our morning greetings and go have an audience with the Queen, Father.”
“…Sigh. I guess I have no choice. Raphtalia, I’m off. I’m leaving my sister and Filo in your care.”
“Yes. Sadeena-nee, shall we talk with Filo a little longer? Things are going to get pretty busy from here on out…”
“Oh, really? Alright then.”

By the way, my Big Sister still doesn’t know that my Father can eat Lucor Fruit. I’m sure she’ll figure it out once we get to the island. So, with that said, we’re all heading to the Queen’s audience. Ren and Itsuki are obediently staying at the castle. In the first world, I couldn’t wait either—I was just like them—but we ended up leaving for the port early in the morning.
“Well then, Heroes… we’re setting off for Cal Mira Island. We look forward to your support.”
“Hmm… it might be good for honing our skills.”
“Evil thrives where there are crowds… so an investigation is necessary.”
“We’ll catch up with you later.”
“… Every single one of them is just doing whatever they want in lockstep.”
My Father muttered in exasperation, but our course of action from here on out was set.
“Well then, Itsuki, please look after Fleon-chan. Ren, you do your best alongside Black Thunder, too.”
“Of course. She’s a comrade who strives for justice, after all.”
“Hmph… That guy’ll stick with me without even being told.”

It’s a huge help that Ren and Itsuki are so cooperative. It’s a world of difference from their one-man-show attitude when we were staying in Melromarc. I suppose it just goes to show that people really can change after meeting Filolial-sama.
“…Father, you should talk to Ren and Itsuki later, too.”
“It’s not like I can just brainwash them!”
I wonder why, but I get the feeling Father’s guard has gone up ever since he saw Ren and Itsuki. Even though Ren and Itsuki have grown and changed…
“As for the rest… I think we should protect the people in Big Sister’s village as soon as possible, with an eye toward the future of colonization.”
“That’s… true. It looks like I’ll be a little late getting to the island. I’ll say thanks to the old man at the weapon shop before heading over to the slave trader’s place…”
And so, we each set out on our own paths. It seems my father gave up on Class Up and went straight to the weapon shop. Ren and Itsuki also set off, each accompanied by Black Thunder and Fleon-chan.
Well then… I’ve got plenty to do myself!

First, as my companion… I suppose I should recruit Yuki-chan. I could bring Kuu and the others along, but… it’ll take time to find the eggs. I can only roughly guess where everyone is. Of course, I’d know if I could just sniff out the eggs. Kou, on the other hand, would find it right away if he just went to the Filolial producer’s place.
“Spear Hero, it seems you’re setting off for your next destination.”
Here, the sage who was invited to the castle speaks to me as I’m getting ready to leave.
“I heard you were going to Cal Mira Island.”

“Before that, I’m going to recruit a new Filolial-sama. Since I’ve been through so many loops, I’ve always been with a Filolial-sama by my side. Now that Fleon-chan’s safety is assured, I can finally bring one back.”
“I see… A Filolial-sama who assists the Spear Hero must be exceptionally talented.”
“That’s right. Filolial-sama is very reliable. But first, I must train her properly.”
“I, too, pride myself on my knowledge of Filolials—I’m confident I’m second to none. I’d be grateful if you could teach me a thing or two so I can learn from you.”
So the immortal is always studying, isn’t he? I must strive to be diligent as well.
“Well then… let’s start by recruiting Filolial-sama, whom we can be sure to secure.”

Yuki-chan, who revived Shieldfreeden in that loop, had asked to meet me in every loop, so let’s go see her. Come to think of it, in the loop where the cycle first began… and in the loop where she turned into that terrifying Filo-tan… I didn’t meet her then. I figured we’d meet eventually, but I’ll grant Yuki-chan’s wish. Given the tone of her voice, I’ll have to give the Tiger Girl special treatment later, too.
“A Filolial named Yuki, you say…”
“The Sage is coming too! Yuki-chan is a Filolial-sama so noble she comes with a pedigree! With the Sage’s advice, Yuki-chan might shine even brighter.”
She might be able to enhance Yuki-chan’s elegance from a perspective different from mine!
“Let’s take Kou along, too. He’s a Filolial-sama who gets along well with his Big Sister!”

With Fleon-chan having Itsuki and Ren having Black Thunder, now is the time for everyone to pair up with a Filolial-sama. Is there a Filolial-sama who can get along well with my Big Sister’s older sister? …Memories of her getting along seamlessly with everyone are coming back to me. She’s truly a wonderful person.
I’ll think about it later. And so, I took the Immortal with me and flew to the ranch where Kou and the Filolial breeders are.
“Oh, that brings back memories.”

When I think back to the ranch that was attacked by Takt and his remnants, my heart still feels like it’s being squeezed. By the way, the Filolial producer barely managed to survive that run. It’s good that they managed to escape, but apparently, they were at a loss because all their precious Filolials had been stolen one by one. I heard they were hidden out by a master of some sort for a while to recover from the shock of the attack.
“Oh? This place is…”
The hermit says as he looks around.
“Do you know this place?”
“Ah, one of my disciples… I had him take over some of my possessions and entrusted him with raising the Filolials. Well, his tendency to prioritize bloodlines was a bit of a problem, though…”
“I see.”
It’s quite a surprise to find the immortal’s disciple in these parts.
“Well then, let’s go. This ranch is where you’ll find the Filolial—the one that’ll become Big Sister’s partner—and the egg where Kou is sleeping!”
With that, I took the hermit and headed over to the Filolial breeder.
“Gua-gua”
Inside the familiar Filolial shed, the Filolial-sama were chirping happily. Ah… this one… is the one who died in that loop. I’ll definitely protect it.
“Hmm… Who’s that?”
“A visitor.”
“To be asked ‘Who’s that?’ and answer ‘a visitor’…”
“Ho ho ho… It’s been a while, hasn’t it?”
The sage standing behind me calls out to the producer.
“Ah, it’s you!?”
Oh? The producer’s eyes widen, and he rushes over toward the sage.
“It’s been a while. Master… What brings you here today?”
“It’s not me—I’ve heard that the Spear Hero here is seeking a Filolial.”
“What!?”
So this hermit was the farmer’s master all along!? Now that’s what I call a surprise. It’s a small world!
“The Spear Hero? This guy?”
“Now, don’t be so rude. I vouch for him.”
“Uh, uh-huh… So, I understand you want a Filolial from our ranch… but which one, exactly?”
With that, the farmer turns his gaze toward the Filolial-sama currently being raised.

“I can certainly say that the Filolial-sama here are wonderful. But let’s save that for later. Immortal, just how many Filolial Kings and Queens do you want? I’d want as many as I could get—enough to call it a kingdom, in fact.”
“If we could produce countless of those lively little ones, that would certainly be a dream come true.”
The Immortal is in a good mood, too.
“I’m sure all the Filolial-sama will cherish you, Immortal!”
“I’m most pleased to hear you say that. Now then, Spear Hero, what about this fellow named Kou?”
“Oh, that’s right. I’m bringing Kou along this time, aren’t I?”
“He’s still an egg.”
“An egg… is he? Well then—”
Before the Breeder—speaking in that mysterious, formal tone—could finish, I turned toward the place where the egg was kept. Then I waited in front of the door, beating the Breeder to it.
“…Do you know the layout of my place?”
The producer tilts his head in confusion, but just then, the door to the shed where the eggs are kept opens.
“So, which egg is it?”
I check the eggs. Sometimes the layout changes when they rearrange things, after all. …Yeah. I’ve found the egg where Kou is sleeping.
“This one, then.”
“Hm? That’s…”
The Sage examines the egg intently.
“You mean this egg, do you? It’s a common breed, not suited for competition, and its durability is average.”

It’s amazing he could tell at a glance. There’s no doubt he deserves the title of Sage. The “Father” in my head points out, “You’re just calling him a Sage on your own!” but he’s not wrong! If I were to study under this Sage, my knowledge of Filolial-sama would deepen beyond measure! There’s a very good chance he knows her secrets as well.
“Immortal, Filolial-sama is a being we all love equally. Yes… just like our own children—whether they’re fast or slow, strong or weak, smart or silly—we love them all equally…”
The producer looked exasperated, but the Immortal bowed his head and trembled.
“How wonderful… Indeed, that is the natural way of thinking for anyone involved with Filolial! Yes! Loving Filolial is what truly matters! I was wrong.”
“M-Master!?”
“No, the Hermit’s keen eye is also remarkable. It’s true that Kou is of ordinary lineage, but he is still Filolial-sama. I do not discriminate based on bloodline.”
“Oh… my, what a true embodiment of love for the Filolials…”
“I don’t really get it, but… Master’s started getting friendly with some weird guy… This isn’t a scam or anything, is it?”

As we were having this exchange, the breeder agreed to give us Kou’s egg. Come to think of it, I should’ve brought Fleon-chan and Black Thunder along. Since I couldn’t provide any proof to back up my argument, I failed to gain the producer’s trust. However, I was able to make a reservation, so I’ve laid the groundwork to purchase a large quantity of Filolial-sama later on.
“Now it’s just Yuki-chan, isn’t it?”
“Is she an egg as well?”
“No… By now, Yuki-chan should have hatched and be in the rearing phase.”
Yuki-chan, being a pedigree bird, has already been shipped out and given a different name. Above all, I know what name Yuki-chan had in the original world and in other loops.
“So… what about that one?”
“It’s a chick named White Swan, currently being raised at the Zeltoble racing bird breeding farm, some distance from here.”
“White Swan—is that the one? I know that one. She’s only about two and a half months old, though…”
Since this is where she was shipped from, I know who the breeder is. So, I brought the Hermit and the breeder with me, and this time we came to the farm where White Swan is being raised.

Oh… we’ve arrived at a farm equipped with a training ground where the Filolial-sama birds can stretch their wings and constantly hone their skills, just as they would when competing in races. It’s a farm with quite high-standard facilities.
“Huh, Owner? When did you get here? Isn’t that earlier than usual?”
The Filolial breeder, looking surprised that I’d brought him here via portal, staggered over to the farm staff.
“Just a moment ago. So… there’s that White Swan, right? There’s someone who wants him…”
“Huh? White Swan? I see. But… I think it’ll be tough to take her away? She’s completely obsessed with running.”
With that, the manager turned his gaze toward the racetrack. And there, on that lap, was Yuki-chan… no, White Swan was running alongside her Filolial friends.
“Gua… Guaaaaaaaah!”

With her slender, beautiful legs and thighs—free of any excess muscle—you can tell just how much passion she pours into running. She’s surely been training every single day since she was born and grew up. Even though her legs hurt when she runs at full speed, she keeps running anyway… There she was, Filolial-sama, worthy of being called an athlete, in the midst of her training. She looks quite stoic.
“White Swan.”
When the manager called out to White Swan like that, she approached, catching her breath after a quick run.
